11   Persons within the scope of the EU Social Security Coordination Regulations
     claiming PIP do not have to satisfy the past presence test (ADM C2026), if they
     can show that they have a genuine and sufficient link to the UK (see ADM
     C2130 and ADM Memo 11/19). However, a person within the personal scope of
     the above legislation who moves to the UK, or returns to the UK, from another
     EEA Member State who does not have a genuine and sufficient link as at
     the first day of potential entitlement may nonetheless be able to satisfy the past
     presence test by other means.
